title: Acetates on a melting ice block

tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. The sunglasses rest folded on top of a clear block of ice melting on hot pale sand, arms closed and the frame sitting level on the wet top face, a thin film of meltwater under them and drops running down the sides of the block into a dark wet patch in the sand. Hard midsummer sun from behind makes the ice glow and the amber tortoiseshell burn where the light passes through it, the lenses throwing a tinted shadow onto the ice. 100mm from sand level, the block in the centre.
